description:
Connect your ChannelzIQ account to understand your YouTube channel’s performance and manage your content workflow. Review channel and video analytics, compare performance over time, read stored transcripts, and work with your ideas, projects, scripts, and publishing calendar.

When you request an action, ChannelzIQ can update drafts, manage supported publishing workflows, and reply to comments through your connected accounts. Some actions publish publicly, change or delete content, or use paid AI features. Available capabilities depend on your ChannelzIQ plan and connected platforms. You can revoke access in ChannelzIQ Settings.

defaultPrompt: Show my connected YouTube channels and summarize performance over the last 28 days.
Compare the performance of two videos from my connected YouTube channel.
